summary: Dispatches collision contact effects (spark and trail particles) per frame. Gated by ArithmeticComparison_9fb0 on the dword_8AB6E4 scoring/effects gate, iterates the effect slot array at this+0x40 over this+0x3C slots, and switches on each slot's type id (slot+4). Type id 5 (raw id 4) spawns collision sparks via ParticleCollisionSpark; trail-type slots spawn particles via ParticleTrailEmitter with jittered positions sampled from the flt_8AB274 noise table through the dword_8AAE70 ring counter. Emission is throttled on dword_7CF8A8 / dword_8AB6E4 / dword_7C5698 (every 20 ticks), deduplicated by remembering the last contact position (a2+56..64) and speed (a2+68), and the byte_7CF9D4 / byte_7CF9EC weather-render flags select the trail magnitude/persistence variant.

operations.description: Enter the dispatch only when ArithmeticComparison_9fb0(&dword_8AB6E4) returns true (effects/scoring gate).
Proceed only when the effect slot count at this+0x3C (this[15]) is greater than zero.
Walk the effect slot array at this+0x40, reading each slot's effect type id from the dword at slot+4.
Skip a slot when its type id is not one of the handled types; the spark branch (raw id 4) additionally requires *(a2+48) != 0.0.
Compute jittered spawn positions as flt_8AB274[(byte)dword_8AAE70++] * 0.25 added to the contact position components.
Throttle emission when dword_7CF8A8 <= threshold and dword_8AB6E4 != 2: emit only every 20th tick of the dword_7C5698 session tick counter.
Spawn collision spark particles via ParticleCollisionSpark for the spark effect type id.
Persist the last contact position (a2+56, +60, +64) and speed value (a2+68) so re-emission is suppressed within a 0.15 speed-difference and 1.0 squared-distance window.
Emit trail particles via ParticleTrailEmitter using the jittered contact position and the velocity vector (a5[0..2]) scaled by 0.1.
The weather/render flags byte_7CF9D4 and byte_7CF9EC select the trail emitter magnitude/persistence variant (1, -1, or 104).
Advance the slot pointer and index until the index reaches the this+0x3C slot count.
Return the slot-iteration flag value v8.

clean_pseudocode: int type = *((int*)*slot + 1);  // type id at slot+4
ParticleCollisionSpark(slot, speed, &pos, velocity, magnitude, a6, a7);
